versions.content: API Function Header Description File Cry If _ Cancel Job Cry If.h This interface dispatches the job cancellation function to the configured crypto driver object. Cry If _ Key Copy Cry If.h This function shall copy all key elements from the source key to a target key. Cry If _ Key - Element Copy Cry If.h This function shall copy a key elements from one key to a target key. Cry If _ Key - Element Copy - Partial Cry If.h Copies a key element to another key element. The key Element Offsets and key Element Copy Length allows to copy just parts of the source key element into the destination key element. Cry If _ Key - Element Get Cry If.h This function shall dispatch the get key element function to the configured crypto driver object. Cry If _ Key - Element Set Cry If.h This function shall dispatch the set key element function to the configured crypto driver object. Cry If _ Key - Exchange Calc - Secret Cry If.h This function shall dispatch the key exchange common shared secret calculation function to the configured crypto driver object. Cry If _ Key - Generate Cry If.h This function shall dispatch the key generate function to the configured crypto driver object. Cry If _ Key Set - Valid Cry If.h This function shall dispatch the set key valid function to the configured crypto driver object. Cry If _ Process - Job Cry If.h This interface dispatches the received jobs to the configured crypto driver object. Cry If _ Random - Seed Cry If.h This function shall dispatch the random seed function to the configured crypto driver object. Det _ Report - Runtime Error Det.h Service to report runtime errors. If a callout has been configured then this callout shall be called.
